model_rules: Products describe the commercial package, entitlement, duration, eligibility, price and fulfilment. Technical features and technology IDs belong to canonical software/device records.
Specification types are repeatable semantic labels. Descriptions are plain-English explanations; values contain the term or quantity.
Physical composition points from an offering to its cartridge, and from the cartridge to parts and its software edition. The software edition does not contain its own carrier.
launch_interpretation: Existing platform campaign assignments are proposed introductions of exchange/support programmes. They do not date a future minor software revision or waive first-year eligibility.
